content.comment_body: Hello, I'm looking to purchase a [product_name] starter kit. I use Apple Mac computers running the current OS Sierra. Which starter kit is compatible with Mac OS, including the necessary software?

Is there a particular reason why you require a 24VAC/DC supply for your setup?

For anyone reading: Mac OS Sierra is not supported by the [product_name] software—it's not listed as compatible. [company_name] technical support will not provide assistance. analysis.insight_summary: Users want to use the [product_name] starter kit and its software on Mac computers running MacOS Sierra. The software does not support MacOS Sierra natively and [company_name] technical support does not provide help for this OS. Mac users are advised to utilize Boot Camp and Windows as a workaround, which complicates installation. There is confusion around software compatibility and user frustration due to insufficient support and outdated documentation for MacOS users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] starter kit and its included software to run directly on MacOS Sierra without needing to use workarounds or extra installation steps.
